name: Lee Jae-in
bio: Lee Jae-in (born February 6, 2004) is a South Korean actress. She first gained recognition through the mystery film Svaha: The Sixth Finger (2019). Other notable works include Racket Boys (2021) and Hi-Five (2025).

credits.title: Gardeners
credits.overview: A story about a public servant whose only hobby is growing plants, and due to a sudden massive debt, teams up with the neighborhood troublemaker to dive into a unique gardening business, causing the quiet town to spiral into unimaginable chaos.

credits.title: Concrete Market
credits.overview: After an apocalyptic earthquake, the only remaining apartment complex turns into a market where survivors buy and sell whatever it takes to survive.

credits.title: Heaven: To the Land of Happiness
credits.overview: In order to find the last happiness of his life, inmate 203 escapes from prison. Nam-sik is poor and sick. These two men happen to meet and obtain a large amount of money. Nam-sik joins inmate 203's journey to find the last happiness.

credits.title: Hard Hit
credits.overview: On his way to work, a bank manager receives an anonymous call claiming there's a bomb under his car seat, and if anyone exits the car, it will explode unless he can pay a ransom.

credits.title: The Battle: Roar to Victory
credits.overview: Over a 4 day period, a fierce battle takes place between Korean independence militias and imperialist Japanese forces in Manchuria, China. The militia includes a master swordsman and an expert marksman.

credits.title: Svaha: The Sixth Finger
credits.overview: Pastor Park, the head of a religious investigation center that exposes cults and cult leaders, begins looking into a suspicious new religion called Deer Mount.

credits.title: Our Body
credits.overview: A woman becomes disenchanted with life after years of studying for an important exam. One lonely evening, she encounters a beautiful, disciplined woman and becomes fascinated with emulating her lifestyle.

credits.title: Adulthood
credits.overview: At her dad's funeral, Kyungun meets her uncle Jaemin, a complete stranger. He bilks her father's insurance money. She demands her money back, but he unashamedly refuses. To get her money back, she joins his next scam.

credits.title: I Can Speak
credits.overview: A grumpy old woman befriends a young civil servant and learns English from him. She then reveals to him her shocking past.

credits.overview: Three horror stories, with each set in the past, present and future.
